course.title: Digital Logic Design
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: Suppose that a data warehouse consists of three dimensions <time, doctor, patient> and two (12) measures <count>, <charge>, where charge is the fee that a doctor charges a patient for a visit. i) Draw the snowflake schema diagram for the data warehouse.
ii) Starting with the base cuboid [day, doctor, patient], what specific OLAP operations should be necessary to list the total fee collected by each doctor in 2010?
iii) To obtain the same list as (ii) write an SQL query assuming the data are stored in a relational database with the schema FEE(day, month, year, doctor, hospital, patient, count, charge).

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2019
